en: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David.

zh: 大衛在獻殿的時候，作這詩歌。

ja: 詩。宮の奉献のための歌。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

しにならなかったからだ。
en: I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
u.src: 1  I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

p.src: 2  LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

ja: め、 あなたは私を癒やしてくださった。
en: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
u.src: 2  LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

p.src: 3  LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

ja: らないよう、命を保ってくださった。
en: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
u.src: 3  LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

ja: 30:3 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
en: 30:3 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 4  Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

en: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
u.src: 4  Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

en: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
u.src: 5  For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
